fields.name: THE FORMAT
fields.value: Quarterfinals and Semifinals are one week each, and the STFL Championship is a two-week cumulative matchup. Brackets reseed after each round. The Semifinal losers play for third place (Article XVI).

fields.name: OFFICIAL RESULTS
